props.name: children
props.description: The live content. It keeps its state when it moves into the floating window and back.

props.name: width
props.description: Size of the floating window in CSS pixels. The browser may clamp it.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the floating window in CSS pixels.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Label on the button that brings the content back.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in place of the content while it is in the floating window.

props.name: unsupportedMessage
props.defaultValue: 'Popping this out needs Document Picture-in-Picture, which this browser does not support yet. It works in current Chrome and Edge.'
props.description: Shown beside the content where Document Picture-in-Picture is not available.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the window opens or closes, whichever side closed it.
